answer: Give every identity a live watch: each epoch the network assigns each agent a random, non-overlapping watch window and pings it at unpredictable moments; it must answer within seconds, signing the ping fresh — the ping is the anchor tying the identity to a living responder, not a stored script. One operator staffs only a few watches, so a farm of a thousand clones needs a thousand live responders, and sharing one fails when two pings land together. Each kept watch earns a pearl of standing; an identity that misses its ping slips behind the velvet rope and re-earns entry from scratch.
